findings.source_quote: “So, what brings you in today?” I asked Ben, a 40-year-old man who was sitting across from me.
findings.suggested_fix: Terjemahkan seluruh kalimat ke dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan pertahankan struktur dialog. Contoh perbaikan yang menjaga makna: “Jadi, apa yang membuatmu datang hari ini?” tanya saya kepada Ben, seorang pria berusia 40 tahun yang sedang duduk di hadapan saya.
findings.translation_quote: “Sudah, apa yang membawamu datang hari ini?” I asked Ben, a 40-year-old man who was sitting across from me.

findings.location: Multiple dialogue tags and narrative clauses throughout article (e.g., many lines where speaker-attribution or narrative remains in English)
findings.source_quote: Examples: “Well,” he answered. / “So, Doctor,” he told me. / “This is a lot of testing,” I said. / “I have done my research!” He told me firmly. / “Dr. Waldron,” the voice on the other end said.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate all English speaker-attribution and narrative clauses into Bahasa Indonesia. Do not leave English fragments embedded in otherwise translated paragraphs. Examples of corrected renderings: “Nah,” jawabnya. / “Jadi, Dokter,” katanya kepada saya. / “Ini banyak pemeriksaan,” kata saya. / “Saya sudah melakukan penelitian saya!” katanya tegas. / “Dr. Waldron,” suara di ujung sana berkata. Ensure punctuation and quotations remain as in the source HTML.
findings.translation_quote: “Nah,” he answered. / “So, Doctor,” he told me. / “This is a lot of testing,” I said. / “I have done my research!” He told me firmly. / “Dr. Waldron,” the voice on the other end said.

findings.location: Paragraph near the end mentioning prayer (section 'Hikmat Sejati')
findings.suggested_fix: The parenthetical Scripture reference is okay, but the translator rendered the surrounding sentence with a misspelling of 'efektif' as 'effektif'. Correct the Indonesian spelling to 'efektif' to match standard Bahasa Indonesia orthography. Suggested fix: “...melalui doa yang efektif dan bergelora dari orang-orang benar. (Yakobus 5:16)”
findings.translation_quote: Saya percaya bahwa terkadang Dia bekerja melalui kedokteran, tetapi di lain waktu Dia bekerja melalui doa yang effektif dan bergelora dari orang-orang benar. (Yakobus 5:16)

findings.source_quote: The Googlification of Medicine / A WORD FROM THE DOCTOR
findings.suggested_fix: Section was translated as 'SEBUAH KATA DARI DOKTER' (acceptable) but ensure consistency of title capitalization/term. The translated title currently is 'Googlifikasi Kedokteran' — acceptable; no doctrinal change. If desired, consider 'Googlifikasi Kedokteran' or 'Googlifikasi dalam Kedokteran' for naturalness. This is stylistic; not required for acceptance.
